critters.name: Fluffalump
critters.fact: Fluffalumps hum when they're happy. Their antennae glow brighter near friends.

critters.name: Glowbug
critters.fact: Glowbugs light up their tails to say hello.

critters.name: Moon Bunny
critters.fact: In Pup Moon's low gravity, a Moon Bunny can hop over a whole house.

critters.name: Crystal Crab
critters.fact: Crystal Crabs walk sideways and grow a new crystal on their shell every year.

critters.name: Grumbler
critters.fact: Grumblers are grumpy because nobody tells them jokes. A few laser zaps send them poofing home.
